text: GCash: Your account is temporarily locked due to suspected fraud. Verify your identity now or it will be closed within 24 hours. Click gcash-verify.example.ph and enter your OTP to reactivate. Ref 2026-0001.

A caller claiming to be from Maya Security Team says: Hello po, this is Maya support. May OTP po kayo na na-receive? Kailangan namin para ma-secure ang account ninyo. Pakibigay nalang po dito para hindi kayo ma-hack.
BDO: Your credit card ending in 9999 has expired. Update your card details now to avoid disruption. Tap bdo-card-update.example. We will never ask for your PIN.
BPI Alert: Unusual activity detected on your account. Log in to bpi-verify.example to confirm if this was you, otherwise your online banking access will be suspended.
J&T Express: Your parcel RTS-2026-000123 is on hold. Pay the redelivery fee of PHP 150 to release it. Send payment to [redacted] or click [redacted-link].
LBC: Your package from abroad needs customs clearance. Pay the insurance fee of PHP 1,850 via the link so we can deliver it. Otherwise ibabalik po namin ang package.
Join our Telegram channel @[redacted] and complete easy tasks. Like 5 videos and earn PHP 200. After task 20, deposit PHP 1,000 to unlock bigger earnings. Sayang ang kita kung hindi kayo sasali.
HR Online: Congratulations! You are hired as a data encoder. Send PHP 500 processing fee to [redacted] to activate your training account. Remote work, no experience needed.
Invest PHP 5,000 today and earn 30% every week. Guaranteed returns, no risk. Matagal na pong tumatakbo ang program namin. Message [redacted] to start.
Hi sweetheart, nakapagpadala na ako ng gift at PHP 50,000 for you from Dubai. Kailangan lang bayaran ang customs fee na PHP 8,000. Pakisettle na lang muna, babayaran ko pagdating ko.
Hello, interested po ako sa item ninyo. Send po muna ng PHP 500 downpayment para ma-reserve ko na siya. I-refund ko po kapag nagkita tayo. Marami na po kasi akong na-scam dati.
GCash: I-scan ang QR code na ito para ma-claim ang inyong PHP 500 cashback [qr-image]. Limited offer hanggang mamayang gabi lang po.
Lazada: Congratulations! You won PHP 50,000 in our anniversary raffle. Pay the processing fee of PHP 2,500 to claim your prize. Click [redacted-link].
SIM Registration: Your number is not yet registered. Register before [date] or your SIM will be deactivated. Click sim-reg.example to update your details and keep your number.
eGovPH: Your digital ID has been suspended due to incomplete records. Verify your identity now at egov-verify.example. Failure to comply will result in a PHP 10,000 fine.
BIR: You have an unsettled tax deficiency. To avoid penalty and a court case, settle PHP 12,400 now via this link. Ibibigay po namin ang official receipt.
This is CICC investigator [redacted]. Your name is linked to a money laundering case. Do not hang up. To clear your name, transfer your balance to the designated account for verification.
Part-time job: Receive payments and forward them to [redacted] account. Keep 10% of every transfer. Legit po, marami na pong sumali. Kailangan mo lang ng GCash.
Shopee: Your order was refunded by mistake. Agent [redacted] will guide you to return the amount. Download AnyDesk so we can assist you remotely. Do not share your PIN.

Tay, naaksidente po si Nanay, nasa hospital po siya. Kailangan po ng PHP 25,000 for surgery. Wag na po kayong tumawag, nasira po ang phone ko. Ito po ang bago kong number. Pakisend nalang po sa GCash [redacted].
Approved loan of PHP 50,000! Low interest, no collateral. Download the app here: [apk-link] to claim. Fast approval po, within 5 minutes.
TikTok Partner: Watch and like videos to earn. We pay PHP 150 per task. Deposit PHP 300 to activate your VIP account and earn double. Message [redacted] to join.
